ExportRequest.description:
Build a parametric shape and export it as a downloadable CAD file.

STEP exports the exact B-rep — the deflection fields are meaningless for
it and ignored. STL is a faceted approximation; its quality fields default
to the tessellation defaults so the exported mesh matches what the
viewport shows.

angular_deflection.description: STL facet angular deflection (rad) between adjacent segments; ignored for STEP (exact B-rep)
angular_deflection.title: Angular Deflection

format.description: Export file format: STEP (exact B-rep) or STL (faceted mesh)
format.title: Format

linear_deflection.description: STL facet linear deflection (mm), same semantics as tessellation; ignored for STEP (exact B-rep)
linear_deflection.title: Linear Deflection

params.description: Parameters of the selected shape kind
params.title: Params

shape.description: Shape kind; must match the params model
shape.title: Shape

FeatureCreate.description:
Create a feature. Appends at the tip; while rolled back, inserts
immediately after the bar and moves the bar to the new feature (§3).

expected_tree_version.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard: the tree_version the client last saw; a stale value is rejected 422 (design §1.2)
expected_tree_version.title: Expected Tree Version

FeatureCreate.title: FeatureCreate

FeatureMutationResponse.description:
Result of a single-feature mutation: the affected feature + the new
tree version (the client's next ``expected_tree_version``).

FeatureRef.description: A whole earlier feature of the same part (e.g. a sketch).
FeatureRef.title: FeatureRef

FeatureReorderRequest.description:
Reorder the whole tree: the complete permutation of feature ids in the
desired evaluation order. Backward-only references (design §2.2 rule 2)
are re-checked under the new order.

order.description: ALL feature ids of the part, in the desired order
order.title: Order

A feature as stored, with the envelope reassembled (design §1.3) and

order_index.description: Dense 0..n-1 evaluation order; only relative position is meaningful to clients (design §1.2)
order_index.title: Order Index

rolled_back.description: True when the feature sits after the rollback bar (§3)
rolled_back.title: Rolled Back

FeatureTreeResponse.description: The ordered feature tree of a part plus its concurrency token.

is immutable — replace the feature to change its kind.

Sketch on a plane — datum planes only in v1 (design §2.1).

``entities``/``constraints`` are structurally-open JSON objects in this
slice: their final pydantic shapes are owned by the "Sketch model +
solver API" backlog item (design §1.4). Sketch entities carry
sketch-local string ids (``"e1"``, ...) per design §2.4.

post.description: Exchange email + password for an access token (uniform 401 on failure).

get.description: The authenticated account (protected: bearer token required).

post.description: Create an account and sign it in (201, envelope 409 on duplicate).
Build + export on the geometry service; pass the file bytes through.

200.description: The exported CAD file, proxied byte-exact from the geometry service: STEP AP214 part 21 (`model/step`, exact B-rep) or binary STL (`model/stl`, faceted mesh). `Content-Disposition` carries the suggested download filename. Byte-deterministic: identical requests produce identical files.

post.description: Build + tessellate on the geometry service; pass the GLB through.

200.description: Binary glTF (GLB) mesh of the requested shape, proxied from the geometry service. The `X-Loft-Properties` header carries `TessellationMetadata` as compact JSON (see `POST /api/v1/geometry/tessellate/meta` for the same payload as a typed JSON body).

post.description: JSON twin of ``/tessellate``: mass properties + mesh stats, no mesh.
Create a part owned by the caller (201; 409 envelope on duplicate name).

delete.description: Delete one of the caller's parts (204; 404 for unknown/foreign ids).

get.description: One of the caller's parts (404 envelope for unknown/foreign ids).
The part's ordered feature tree (404 for unknown/foreign parts).

post.description: Create a feature (201; 422 envelope on stale version / bad refs).

put.description: Apply a full permutation of the tree (backward-only refs re-checked).

delete.description: Delete a feature (409 envelope listing dependents when referenced).

get.description: One feature of the caller's part.

patch.description: Rename and/or replace a feature's params.

put.description: Move the rollback bar (null = bar at the tip).
